qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Massive iOS ecosystem lock-in (iCloud, iMessage, cross-device continuity, Apple Watch, and Apple Pay) creates insurmountable consumer switching costs proved by >90% iPhone retention and multi-decade median ROIC of 76.9%. Pricing power proven by higher ASPs via Pro/Pro Max mix shift and recurring Services expansion (26%+ of total revenue at ~74% gross margins). Primary erosion risks include antitrust scrutiny on App Store take-rates (EU DMA) and potential renegotiation or capping of Google search revenue-share (TAC).
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global consumer hardware and services ecosystem hegemon with >2.2B active installed devices and >90% iPhone customer retention. Pricing power demonstrated by Pro-tier mix escalation and high-margin Services growth (>$109B). Pristine balance sheet with LT debt / NI of 0.70x and >$100B in annual operating cash flow. Disruption runway set at CAP 15Y after a -5Y haircut for TSMC Taiwan foundry concentration and China assembly exposure, actively mitigated by diversification into India and TSMC Arizona. [5-10Y g: device & services volume 3.5% + ASP & pricing 1.0% + services mix 1.5% - regulatory TAC/DMA margin drag 0.5% + net share repurchases 2.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year GAAP ROIC median of 76.9% (reaching 98.1% in FY2025). Peak-to-peak Owner EPS compounded from $2.08 in FY2016 to $7.47 in FY2025 (16.4% CAGR). FCF conversion exceeds 92% across cycles. Gross margins expanded from 38% to >46% as high-margin Services reached $109.2B in FY2025. Long-term debt of $78.3B against EBIT of $133.1B and Net Income of $112.0B (debt/NI = 0.70x). More than $700B returned through disciplined share repurchases over the last decade, reducing share count by over 35%.
